chapter: Central Avenue clubs, Nordskog, Sheffield and Music Town
title: The Jockey Club at Twenty-third and Central
summary: His third place was the Jockey Club next to the Lincoln Theater, before he and Will Heflin took the Alabam.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And then, the third place you had was...
The uh...what'd I tell...what was the name of the place?
It just left my mind. You just told me. I'm sorry. Oh, we'll think of it in a minute, won't we?
Jockey Club. Thank you. And that was where?
Twenty-third and Central, right next to the old theater there.
Yeah, the Lincoln. Then I moved down and went over to...took the Alabam--Will Heflin and I--after Mosby and everything left.
